payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance improvements of the introduced approach on the RACE dataset, detailing the percentage gains over previous models.

claims.text: The introduced approach (DFN) improves performance on RACE-M by 7.8% over GA and 7.3% over Stanford AR.
On RACE-H, the DFN approach outperforms previous models by 1.5% over GA and 2.7% over Stanford AR.
Ensemble models using the introduced approach achieve a performance boost of 4-5% compared to previous methods.
